a primitive root; properly, to dig; figuratively, to plot; generally, to bore or open:--dig, X make (a banquet), open.
usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of 3738 (through the common idea of planning implied in a bargain); to purchase:--buy, prepare. see HEBREW for 03738
from 3739; a purchase:--provision. see HEBREW for 03739
feminine of 3733; a meadow:--cottage. see HEBREW for 03733
of uncertain derivation; a cherub or imaginary figure:--cherub, (plural) cherubims.
the same as 3742; Kerub, a place in Bab.: -Cherub. see HEBREW for 03742
(Aramaic) from 3745; a herald:--herald. see HEBREW for 03745
(Aramaic) probably of Greek origin; to proclaim:--make a proclamation.
perhaps an abridged plural of 3733 in the sense of leader (of the flock); a life-guardsman:--captains, Cherethites (from the margin). see HEBREW for 03733
from 3772; a cut; Kerith, a brook of Palestine: -Cherith. see HEBREW for 03772
from 3772; a cutting (of the matrimonial bond), i.e. divorce:--divorce(-ment). see HEBREW for 03772
expanded from the same as 3522; a rim or top margin:--compass. see HEBREW for 03522
probably of foreign origin; the crocus:--saffron.
of foreign derivation; Karkemish, a place in Syria:--Carchemish.
of Persian origin; Karkas, a eunuch of Xerxes: -Carcas.
from 3769; a dromedary (from its rapid motion as if dancing):--swift beast. see HEBREW for 03769
from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a garden or vineyard:--vines, (increase of the) vineyard(-s), vintage. See also 1021. see HEBREW for 01021
active participle of an imaginary denominative from 3754; a vinedresser:--vine dresser (as one or two words). see HEBREW for 03754
from 3754; gardener; Karmi, the name of three Israelites:--Carmi. see HEBREW for 03754
patronymically from 3756; a Karmite or descendant of Karmi:--Carmites. see HEBREW for 03756
probably of foreign origin; carmine, a deep red: -crimson.
from 3754; a planted field (garden, orchard, vineyard or park); by implication, garden produce:--full (green) ears (of corn), fruitful field (place), plentiful (field). see HEBREW for 03754
the same as 3759; Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine:--Carmel, fruitful (plentiful) field, (place). see HEBREW for 03759
patron from 3760; a Karmelite or inhabitant of Karmel (the town):--Carmelite. see HEBREW for 03760
feminine of 3761; a Karmelitess or female inhabitant of Karmel:--Carmelitess. see HEBREW for 03761
of uncertain derivation; Keran, an aboriginal Idumaean:--Cheran.
(Aramaic) corresponding to 3678; a throne:--throne. see HEBREW for 03678
from 3697; to lay waste:--waste. see HEBREW for 03697
a primitive root; to bend the knee; by implication, to sink, to prostrate:--bow (down, self), bring down (low), cast down, couch, fall, feeble, kneeling, sink, smite (stoop) down, subdue, X very.
from 3766; the leg (from the knee to the ankle) of men or locusts (only in the dual):--leg. see HEBREW for 03766
of foreign origin; byssus or fine vegetable wool: -green.
a primitive root; to dance (i.e. whirl): -dance(-ing).
by variation from 7164; the paunch or belly (as swelling out):--belly. see HEBREW for 07164
of foreign origin; Karshena, a courtier of Xerxes:--Carshena.

a primitive root; to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces):--be chewed, be con-(feder-)ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league ((covenant)), X lose, perish, X utterly, X want.
passive participle feminine of 3772; something cut, i.e. a hewn timber:--beam. see HEBREW for 03772

probably from 3772 in the sense of executioner; a Kerethite or life-guardsman (compare 2876) (only collectively in the singular as plural):--Cherethims, Cherethites. see HEBREW for 03772 see HEBREW for 02876
apparently by transposition for 3532; a young sheep:--lamb. see HEBREW for 03532
feminine of 3775; a young ewe:--lamb. see HEBREW for 03775
from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Kesed, a relative of Abraham:--Onesed.

(occasionally with enclitic) Kasdiymah {kas-dee'- maw}; towards the Kasdites:--into Chaldea), patronymically from 3777 (only in the plural); a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people:--Chaldeans, Chaldees, inhabitants of Chaldea.
(Aramaic) corresponding to 3778; a Chaldaean or inhabitant of Chaldaea; by implication, a Magian or professional astrologer:--Chaldean. see HEBREW for 03778
a primitive root; to grow fat (i.e. be covered with flesh):--be covered. Compare 3680. see HEBREW for 03680
from 3782; properly, a feller, i.e. an axe: -ax. see HEBREW for 03782

a primitive root; to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter, stumble, faint or fall:--bereave (from the margin), cast down, be decayed, (cause to) fail, (cause, make to) fall (down, -ing), feeble, be (the) ruin(-ed, of), (be) overthrown, (cause to) stumble, X utterly, be weak.
from 3782; properly, a tottering, i.e. ruin:--fall. see HEBREW for 03782
a primitive root; properly, to whisper a spell, i.e. to inchant or practise magic:--sorcerer, (use) witch(-craft).
from 3784; magic:--sorcery, witchcraft. see HEBREW for 03784
from 3784; a magician:--sorcerer. see HEBREW for 03784
a primitive root properly, to be straight or right; by implication, to be acceptable; also to succeed or prosper:-- direct, be right, prosper.
from 3787; success, advantage:--equity, good, right. see HEBREW for 03787
a primitive root; to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe):--describe, record, prescribe, subscribe, write(-ing, -ten).
(Aramaic) corresponding to 3789:--write(-ten). see HEBREW for 03789
from 3789; something written, i.e. a writing, record or book:--register, scripture, writing. see HEBREW for 03789
(Aramaic) corresponding to 3791:--prescribing, writing(-ten). see HEBREW for 03791
from 3789; a letter or other mark branded on the skin:--X any (mark). see HEBREW for 03789

or Kittiyiy {kit-tee-ee'}; patrial from an unused name denoting Cyprus (only in the plural); a Kittite or Cypriote; hence, an islander in general, i.e. the Greeks or Romans on the shores opposite Palestine:--Chittim, Kittim.
from 3807; beaten, i.e. pure (oil): -beaten. see HEBREW for 03807
from an unused root meaning to compact; a wall (as gathering inmates):--wall.
(Aramaic) corresponding to 3796:--wall. see HEBREW for 03796
from 3796 and 376; wall of a man; Kithlish, a place in Palestine:--Kithlish. see HEBREW for 03796 see HEBREW for 0376
a primitive root; properly, to carve or engrave, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe indelibly:--mark.
from 3799; properly, something carved out, i.e. ore; hence, gold (pure as originally mined):--((most) fine, pure) gold(-en wedge). see HEBREW for 03799
or kuttoneth {koot-to'-neth}; from an unused root meaning to cover (compare 3802); a shirt:--coat, garment, robe. see HEBREW for 03802

from an unused root meaning to clothe; the shoulder (proper, i.e. upper end of the arm; as being the spot where the garments hang); figuratively, side-piece or lateral projection of anything:--arm, corner, shoulder(-piece), side, undersetter.

a primitive root; to enclose; hence (in a friendly sense) to crown, (in a hostile one) to besiege; also to wait (as restraining oneself):--beset round, compass about, be crowned inclose round, suffer.
from 3803; properly, a circlet, i.e. a diadem: -crown. see HEBREW for 03803
feminine active participle of 3803; the capital of a column:--chapiter. see HEBREW for 03803
a primitive root; to butt or pound:--bray.
a primitive root; to bruise or violently strike:--beat (down, to pieces), break in pieces, crushed, destroy, discomfit, smite, stamp.

or lowi {lo}; or loh (Deut. 3:11) {lo}; a primitive particle; not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles (as follows):--X before, + or else, ere, + except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), (X as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, + surely, + as truly as, + of a truth, + verily, for want, + whether, without.
(Aramaic) or lah (Aramaic) (Dan. 4:32) {law}; corresponding to 3808:--or even, neither, no(-ne, -r), ((can-))not, as nothing, without. see HEBREW for 03808

or Low Dbar (2 Samuel 9:4,5) {lo deb-ar'}; or Lidbir (Joshua 13:26) {lid-beer'}; (probably rather Lodbar {lo-deb-ar'}); from 3808 and 1699; pastureless; Lo-Debar, a place in Palestine:--Debir, Lo-debar. see HEBREW for 05 see HEBREW for 03808 see HEBREW for 01699
a primitive root; to tire; (figuratively) to be (or make) disgusted:--faint, grieve, lothe, (be, make) weary (selves).
from 3811; weary; Leah, a wife of Jacob:--Leah. see HEBREW for 03811
a primitive root; to muffle:--cover.
from 3813 (or perhaps for active participle of 3874); properly, muffled, i.e. silently:--softly. see HEBREW for 03813 see HEBREW for 03874
from the prepositional prefix and 410; (belonging) to God; Lael an Israelite:--Lael. see HEBREW for 0410
or l owm {leh-ome'}; from an unused root meaning to gather; a community:--nation, people.
plural of 3816; communities; Leum mim, an Arabian:--Leummim. see HEBREW for 03816
from 3808 and 5971 with pronominal suffix; not my people; Lo-Ammi, the symbolic name of a son of Hosea:--Lo-ammi. see HEBREW for 03808 see HEBREW for 05971
from 3808 and 7355; not pitied; Lo- Ruchamah, the symbol. name of a son of Hosea:--Lo-ruhamah. see HEBREW for 03808 see HEBREW for 07355

a form of 3824; the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything:--+ care for, comfortably, consent, X considered, courag(-eous), friend(-ly), ((broken-), (hard-), (merry-), (stiff-), (stout-), double) heart((-ed)), X heed, X I, kindly, midst, mind(-ed), X regard((-ed)), X themselves, X unawares, understanding, X well, willingly, wisdom. see HEBREW for 03824
(Aramaic) corresponding to 3820:--heart. see HEBREW for 03820
plural of 3833; lionesses; Lebaoth, a place in Palestine:--Lebaoth. See also 1034. see HEBREW for 03833 see HEBREW for 01034

a primitive root; properly, to be enclosed (as if with fat); by implication (as denominative from 3824) to unheart, i.e. (in a good sense) transport (with love), or (in a bad sense) stultify; also (as denominative from 3834) to make cakes:--make cakes, ravish, be wise. see HEBREW for 03824 see HEBREW for 03834

from 3823; the heart (as the most interior organ); used also like 3820:--+ bethink themselves, breast, comfortably, courage, ((faint), (tender-)heart((-ed)), midst, mind, X unawares, understanding. see HEBREW for 03823 see HEBREW for 03820
(Aramaic) corresponding to 3824:--heart. see HEBREW for 03824
feminine of 3820; the heart:--heart. see HEBREW for 03820
for 3852; flame:--flame. see HEBREW for 03852
or lbonah {leb-o-naw'}; from 3836; frankincense (from its whiteness or perhaps that of its smoke): -(frank-)incense. see HEBREW for 03836
the same as 3828; Lebonah, a place in Palestine:--Lebonah. see HEBREW for 03828
or lbush {leb-oosh'}; from 3847; a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphem.) a wife:--apparel, clothed with, clothing, garment, raiment, vestment, vesture. see HEBREW for 03847
(Aramaic) corresponding to 3830:--garment. see HEBREW for 03830
a primitive root; to overthrow; intransposed, to fall:--fall.

or (Ezek. 19:2) lbiyao {leb-ee-yaw'}; irreg. masculine plural lbaviym {leb-aw-eem'}; irreg. feminine plural lbaeowth {leb-aw-oth'}; from an unused root men. to roar; a lion (properly, a lioness as the fiercer (although not a roarer; compare 738)):--(great, old, stout) lion, lioness, young (lion). see HEBREW for 0738
or rather lbibah {leb-ee-baw'}; from 3823 in its original sense of fatness (or perhaps of folding); a cake (either as fried or turned):--cake. see HEBREW for 03823
a primitive root; to be (or become) white; also (as denominative from 3843) to make bricks:--make brick, be (made, make) white(-r). see HEBREW for 03843
or (Gen. 49:12) laben {law-bane'}; from 3835; white:--white. see HEBREW for 03835
the same as 3836; Laban, a Mesopotamian; also a place in the Desert:--Laban. see HEBREW for 03836
or Lbanah {leb-aw-naw'}; the same as 3842; Lebana or Lebanah, one of the Nethinim:--Lebana, Lebanah. see HEBREW for 03842
from 3835; some sort of whitish tree, perhaps the storax:--poplar. see HEBREW for 03835
from 3835; properly, whiteness, i.e. (by implication) transparency:--paved. see HEBREW for 03835
the same as 3839; Libnah, a place in the Desert and one in Palestine:--Libnah. see HEBREW for 03839
from 3835; properly, (the) white, i.e. the moon:--moon. See also 3838. see HEBREW for 03835 see HEBREW for 03838
from 3835; a brick (from the whiteness of the clay):--(altar of) brick, tile. see HEBREW for 03835
from 3825; (the) white mountain (from its snow); Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine:--Lebanon. see HEBREW for 03825
from 3835; white; Libni, an Israelite:--Libni. see HEBREW for 03835
patronymically from 3845; a Libnite or descendants of Libni (collectively):--Libnites. see HEBREW for 03845

or labesh {law-bashe'}; a primitive root; properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on a garment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively:--(in) apparel, arm, array (self), clothe (self), come upon, put (on, upon), wear.
(Aramaic) corresponding to 3847:--clothe. see HEBREW for 03847
from an unused root apparently meaning to deepen or hollow (like 3537); a log or measure for liquids:--log (of oil). see HEBREW for 03537
from an unused root of uncertain signification; Lod, a place in Palestine:--Lod.
from an usused root meaning to gleam; a flash; figuratively, a sharply polished blade or point of a weapon:--blade, bright, flame, glittering.
or lahebeth {lah-eh'-beth}; feminine of 3851, and meaning the same:--flame(-ming), head (of a spear). see HEBREW for 03851
plural of 3851; flames; Lehabim, a son of Mizrain, and his descendants:--Lehabim. see HEBREW for 03851
from an unused root meaning to be eager; intense mental application:--study.
from an unused root meaning to glow (compare 3851) or else to be earnest (compare 3854); Lahad, an Israelite:--Lahad. see HEBREW for 03851 see HEBREW for 03854
a primitive root meaning properly, to burn, i.e. (by implication) to be rabid (figuratively, insane); also (from the exhaustion of frenzy) to languish:--faint, mad.
a primitive root; properly, to lick, i.e. (by implication) to blaze:--burn (up), set on fire, flaming, kindle.
from 3857; a blaze; also (from the idea of enwrapping) magic (as covert):--flaming, enchantment. see HEBREW for 03857
a primitive root; properly, to burn in, i.e. (figuratively) to rankle:--wound.
from the prepositional prefix meaning to or for and 2005; popularly for if; hence, therefore:--for them (by mistake for prepositional suffix). see HEBREW for 02005
(Aramaic) corresponding to 3860; therefore; also except:--but, except, save, therefore, wherefore. see HEBREW for 03860
probably from an unused root meaning to gather; an assembly:--company.
or lu {loo}; or luw {loo}; a conditional particle; if; by implication (interj. as a wish) would that!:--if (haply), peradventure, I pray thee, though, I would, would God (that).

or Lubbiy (Dan. 11:43) {loob-bee'}; partrial from a name probably derived from an unused root meaning to thirst, i.e. a dry region; apparently a Libyan or inhabitant of interior Africa (only in plural): -Lubim(-s), Libyans.
probably of foreign derivation; Lud, the name of two nations:--Lud, Lydia.
or Luwdiyiy {loo-dee-ee'}; patrial from 3865; a Ludite or inhabitants of Lud (only in plural):--Ludim. Lydians. see HEBREW for 03865
a primitive root; properly, to twine, i.e. (by implication) to unite, to remain; also to borrow (as a form of obligation) or (caus.) to lend:--abide with, borrow(-er), cleave, join (self), lend(-er).

a primitive root; to turn aside (compare 3867, 3874 and 3885), i.e. (literally) to depart, (figuratively) be perverse:--depart, froward, perverse(-ness). see HEBREW for 03867 see HEBREW for 03874 see HEBREW for 03885
probably of foreign origin; some kind of nut-tree, perhaps the almond:--hazel.
probably from 3869 (as growing there); Luz, the name of two places in Palestine:--Luz. see HEBREW for 03869
or luach {loo'-akh}; from a primitive root; probably meaning to glisten; a tablet (as polished), of stone, wood or metal:--board, plate, table.
or Luchowth (Jer. 48:5) {loo-khoth'}; from the same as 3871; floored; Luchith, a place East of the Jordan:--Luhith. see HEBREW for 03871
active participle of 3907; (the) enchanter; Lochesh, an Israelite:--Hallohesh, Haloshesh (includ. the article). see HEBREW for 03907
a primitive root; to wrap up:--cast, wrap.
from 3874; a veil:--covering. see HEBREW for 03874
the same as 3875; Lot, Abraham's nephew:--Lot. see HEBREW for 03875
from 3875; covering; Lotan, an Idumaean: -Lotan. see HEBREW for 03875
from 3867; attached; Levi, a son of Jacob:--Levi. See also 3879, 3881. see HEBREW for 03867 see HEBREW for 03879 see HEBREW for 03881
(Aramaic) corresponding to 3880:--Levite. see HEBREW for 03880
from 3867; something attached, i.e. a wreath: -ornament. see HEBREW for 03867
or Leviy {lay-vee'}; patronymically from 3878; a Levite or descendant of Levi:--Leviite. see HEBREW for 03878

from 3867; a wreathed animal, i.e. a serpent (especially the crocodile or some other large sea- monster); figuratively, the constellation of the dragon; also as a symbol of Bab.:--leviathan, mourning. see HEBREW for 03867
from an unused root meaning to fold back; a spiral step:--winding stair. Compare 3924. see HEBREW for 03924
or luwley {loo lay'}; from 3863 and 3808; if not:--except, had not, if (...not), unless, were it not that. see HEBREW for 03863 see HEBREW for 03808

or liyn {leen}; a primitive root; to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain):--abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night).
a primitive root; to gulp; figuratively, to be rash:--swallow down (up).

a primitive root; properly, to make mouths at, i.e. to scoff; hence (from the effort to pronounce a foreign language) to interpret, or (generally) intercede:--ambassador, have in derision, interpreter, make a mock, mocker, scorn(-er, -ful), teacher.
a primitive root; to knead:--knead.
from 3888; kneading; Lush, a place in Palestine:--Laish (from the margin). Compare 3919. see HEBREW for 03888 see HEBREW for 03919
(Aramaic) from a root corresponding to 3867; properly, adhesion, i.e. (as preposition) with:--X thee. see HEBREW for 03867
from 3868; perverseness:--perverse. see HEBREW for 03868
from an unused root meaning to be new; fresh, i.e. unused or undried:--green, moist.
from the same as 3892; freshness, i.e. vigor: -natural force. see HEBREW for 03892
or lachum {law-khoom'}; passive participle of 3898; properly, eaten, i.e. food; also flesh, i.e. body:--while...is eating, flesh. see HEBREW for 03898
from an unused root meaning to be soft; the cheek (from its fleshiness); hence, the jaw-bone:--cheek (bone), jaw (bone).
a form of 3895; Lechi, a place in Palestine:--Lehi. Compare also 7437. see HEBREW for 03895 see HEBREW for 07437
a primitive root; to lick:--lick (up).
a primitive root; to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction):--devour, eat, X ever, fight(-ing), overcome, prevail, (make) war(-ring).
from 3898; food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it):--((shew-))bread, X eat, food, fruit, loaf, meat, victuals. See also 1036. see HEBREW for 03898 see HEBREW for 01036
(Aramaic) corresponding to 3899:--feast. see HEBREW for 03899
from 3898, battle:--war. see HEBREW for 03898

from 3899; foodful; Lachmi, an Israelite; or rather probably a brief form (or perhaps erroneous transcription) for 1022:-- Lahmi. See also 3433. see HEBREW for 03899 see HEBREW for 03433 see HEBREW for 01022
probably by erroneous transcription for Lachmam {lakh-mawm'}; from 3899; food-like; Lachmam or Lachmas, a place in Palestine:--Lahmam. see HEBREW for 03899
(Aramaic) from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a concubine:--concubine.
a primitive root; properly, to press, i.e. (figuratively) to distress:--afflict, crush, force, hold fast, oppress(-or), thrust self.
from 3905; distress:--affliction, oppression. see HEBREW for 03905
a primitive root; to whisper; by implication, to mumble a spell (as a magician):--charmer, whisper (together).

from 3907; properly, a whisper, i.e. by implication, (in a good sense) a private prayer, (in a bad one) an incantation; concretely, an amulet:--charmed, earring, enchantment, orator, prayer. see HEBREW for 03907

a form of 3814 or else participle from 3874; properly, covered, i.e. secret; by implication, incantation; also secrecy or (adverb) covertly: -enchantment, privily, secretly, softly. see HEBREW for 03814 see HEBREW for 03874
probably from 3874; a gum (from its sticky nature), probably ladanum:--myrrh. see HEBREW for 03874
from an unused root meaning to hide; a kind of lizard (from its covert habits):--lizard.
masculine plural of passive participle of 3913; hammered (i.e. oppressed) ones; Letushim, an Arabian tribe:--Letushim. see HEBREW for 03913
a primitive root; properly, to hammer out (an edge), i.e. to sharpen:--instructer, sharp(-en), whet.
a form of 3880; a wreath:--addition. see HEBREW for 03880

or (Isa. 21:11) leyl {lale}; also laylah {lah'- yel-aw}; from the same as 3883; properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity:--((mid-))night (season). see HEBREW for 03883
(Aramaic) corresponding to 3815:--night. see HEBREW for 03815
from 3915; a night spectre:--screech owl. see HEBREW for 03915
from 3888 in the sense of crushing; a lion (from his destructive blows):--(old)lion. see HEBREW for 03888
the same as 3918; Laish, the name of two places in Palestine:--Laish. Compare 3889. see HEBREW for 03918 see HEBREW for 03889

a primitive root; to catch (in a net, trap or pit); generally, to capture or occupy; also to choose (by lot); figuratively, to cohere:--X at all, catch (self), be frozen, be holden, stick together, take.
from 3920; something to capture with, i.e. a noose:--being taken. see HEBREW for 03920
from 3212; a journey; Lekah, a place in Palestine: -Lecah. see HEBREW for 03212
from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Lakish, a place in Palestine:--Lachish.
from the same as 3883; a loop:--loop. see HEBREW for 03883
a primitive root; properly, to goad, i.e. (by implication) to teach (the rod being an Oriental incentive):(un-) accustomed, X diligently, expert, instruct, learn, skilful, teach(-er, - ing).
a prol. and separable form of the prepositional prefix; to or for:--at, for, to, upon.
or Lmow el {lem-o-ale'}; from 3926 and 410; (belonging) to God; Lemuel or Lemoel, a symbolic name of Solomon: -Lemuel. see HEBREW for 03926 see HEBREW for 0410
or limmud {lim-mood'}; from 3925; instructed: -accustomed, disciple, learned, taught, used. see HEBREW for 03925
from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Lemek, the name of two antediluvian patriarchs:--Lamech.
from 3886; the gullet:--throat. see HEBREW for 03886
a primitive root; to deride:--mock.
a primitive root; to deride; by implication (as if imitating a foreigner) to speak unintelligibly:--have in derision, laugh (to scorn), mock (on), stammering.
from 3932; derision, scoffing:--derision, scorn (-ing). see HEBREW for 03932
from 3932; a buffoon; also a foreigner:--mocker, stammering. see HEBREW for 03932
from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Ladah, an Israelite:--Laadah.
from the same as 3935; Ladan, the name of two Israelites:--Laadan. see HEBREW for 03935
a primitive root; to speak in a foreign tongue: -strange language.
a primitive root; to swallow greedily; causatively, to feed:--feed.
from an unused root supposed to mean to curse; wormwood (regarded as poisonous, and therefore accursed):--hemlock, wormwood.
or lappid {lap-peed'}; from an unused root probably meaning to shine; a flambeau, lamp or flame:--(fire-)brand, (burning) lamp, lightning, torch.
feminine plural of 3940; Lappidoth, the husband of Deborah:--Lappidoth. see HEBREW for 03940
from the prepositional prefix (to or for) and 6440; anterior:--before. see HEBREW for 06440
a primitive root; properly, to bend, i.e. (by implication) to clasp; also (reflexively) to turn around or aside:--take hold, turn aside (self).
from 3887; derision:--scornful(-ning). see HEBREW for 03887

the same as 4976; Mattan, the name of a priest of Baal, and of an Israelite:--Mattan. see HEBREW for 04976
(Aramaic) corresponding to 4979:--gift. see HEBREW for 04979
feminine of 4976; a present; specifically (in a good sense), a sacrificial offering, (in a bad sense) a bribe:--gift. see HEBREW for 04976
the same as 4979; Mattanah, a place in the Desert:--Mattanah. see HEBREW for 04979
probably patrial from an unused noun meaning slenderness; a Mithnite, or inhabitant of Methen:--Mithnite.
from 4976; liberal; Mattenai, the name of three Israelites:--Mattenai. see HEBREW for 04976
or Mattanyahuw {mat-tan-yaw'-hoo}; from 4976 and 3050; gift of Jah; Mattanjah, the name of ten Israelites:--Mattaniah. see HEBREW for 04976 see HEBREW for 03050
from 5375; (used as abstractly) supreme exaltation:--exalted. see HEBREW for 05375
a primitive root; to suck, by implication, to relish, or (intransitively) be sweet:--be (made, X take) sweet.
from 4985; figuratively, pleasantness (of discourse):--sweetness. see HEBREW for 04985
from 4985; sweetness:--sweetness. see HEBREW for 04985
from 4985; a dainty, i.e. (generally) food:--feed sweetly. see HEBREW for 04985
feminine of 4987; sweetness; Mithkah, a place in the Desert:--Mithcah. see HEBREW for 04987
of Persian origin; Mithredath, the name of two Persians:--Mithredath.
feminine of 4976 abbreviated form; a present:--gift. see HEBREW for 04976
for 4993; gift of Jah; Mattattah, an Israelite:--Mattathah. see HEBREW for 04993
or Mattithyahuw {mat-tith-yaw'-hoo}; from 4991 and 3050; gift of Jah; Mattithjah, the name of four Israelites:-- Mattithiah. see HEBREW for 04991 see HEBREW for 03050

a primitive particle of incitement and entreaty, which may usually be rendered: "I pray," "now," or "then"; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction:--I beseech (pray) thee (you), go to, now, oh.
apparently from 5106 in the sense of harshness from refusal; properly, tough, i.e. uncooked (flesh):--raw. see HEBREW for 05106
of Egyptian origin; No (i.e. Thebes), the capital of Upper Egypt:--No. Compare 528. see HEBREW for 0528
or noywd {node}; also (feminine) no)dah {no-daw'}; from an unused root of uncertain signification; a (skin or leather) bag (for fluids):--bottle.
a primitive root; properly, to be at home, i.e. (by implication) to be pleasant (or suitable), i.e. beautiful:--be beautiful, become, be comely.
from 4998; a home; figuratively, a pasture:--habitation, house, pasture, pleasant place. see HEBREW for 04998
from 4998 or 5116; suitable, or beautiful:--becometh, comely, seemly. see HEBREW for 04998 see HEBREW for 05116
a primitive root; properly, to whisper, i.e. (by implication) to utter as a oracle:--say.
from 5001; an oracle:--(hath) said, saith. see HEBREW for 05001
a primitive root; to commit adultery; figuratively, to apostatize:--adulterer(-ess), commit(-ing) adultery, woman that breaketh wedlock.
from 5003; adultery:--adultery. see HEBREW for 05003
from 5003; adultery:--adultery. see HEBREW for 05003
a primitive root; to scorn; or (Ecclesiastes 12:5) by interchange for 5132, to bloom:--abhor, (give occasion to) blaspheme, contemn, despise, flourish, X great, provoke. see HEBREW for 05132
or nematsah {neh-aw-tsaw'}; from 5006; scorn:--blasphemy. see HEBREW for 05006
a primitive root; to groan:--groan.
from 5008; a groan:--groaning. see HEBREW for 05008
a primitive root; to reject:--abhor, make void.
the same as 5108; fruit; Nob, a place in Palestine:--Nob. see HEBREW for 05108
a primitive root; to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse):--prophesy(-ing), make self a prophet.
(Aramaic) corresponding to 5012:--prophesy. see HEBREW for 05012
a primitive root; to pierce; to be hollow, or (figuratively) foolish:--hollow, vain.
probably of foreign derivation; Nebo, the name of a Babylonian deity, also of a mountain in Moab, and of a place in Palestine:--Nebo.
from 5012; a prediction (spoken or written):--prophecy. see HEBREW for 05012
(Aramaic) corresponding to 5016; inspired teaching:--prophesying. see HEBREW for 05016
of foreign origin; Nebuzaradan, a Babylonian general:--Nebuzaradan.

or Nbukadneotstsar (2 Kings 24:1, 10) {neb-oo-kad-nets-tsar'}; or Nbuwkadnetstsar (Esther 2:6; Daniel 1:18) {neb-oo-kad-nets-tsar'}; or Nbuwkadreotstsar {neb-oo-kad-rets-tsar'}; or Nbuwkadreltstsowr (Ezra 2:1; Jeremiah 49:28) {neb-oo-kad-rets-tsore'}; or foreign derivation; Nebukadnetstsar (or -retstsar, or -retstsor), king of Babylon:--Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadrezzar. see HEBREW for 010
(Aramaic) corresponding to 5019:--Nebuchadnezzar. see HEBREW for 05019
of foreign derivation; Nebushazban, Nebuchadnezzar's chief eunuch:--Nebushazban.
feminine plural from the same as 5011; fruits; Naboth, an Israelite:--Naboth. see HEBREW for 05011
(Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; a largess:--reward.
a primitive root; to bark (as a dog):--bark.
from 5024; a bark; Nobach, the name of an Israelite, and of a place East of the Jordan:--Nobah. see HEBREW for 05024
of foreign origin; Nibchaz, a deity of the Avites:--Nibhaz.
a primitive root; to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care:--(cause to) behold, consider, look (down), regard, have respect, see.
from 5027; regard; Nebat, the father of Jeroboam I:--Nebat. see HEBREW for 05027
(Aramaic) corresponding to 5030; a prophet:--prophet. see HEBREW for 05030
from 5012; a prophet or (generally) inspired man:--prophecy, that prophesy, prophet. see HEBREW for 05012
feminine of 5030; a prophetess or (generally) inspired woman; by implication, a poetess; by association a prophet's wife:--prophetess. see HEBREW for 05030
or Nbayoth {neb-aw-yoth'}; feminine plural from 5107; fruitfulnesses; Nebajoth, a son of Ismael, and the country settled by him:--Nebaioth, Nebajoth. see HEBREW for 05107
from an unused root meaning to burst forth; a fountain:--spring.

a primitive root; to wilt; generally, to fall away, fail, faint; figuratively, to be foolish or (morally) wicked; causatively, to despise, disgrace:--disgrace, dishounour, lightly esteem, fade (away, - ing), fall (down, -ling, off), do foolishly, come to nought, X surely, make vile, wither.

or nebel {nay'-bel}; from 5034; a skin-bag for liquids (from collapsing when empty); hence, a vase (as similar in shape when full); also a lyre (as having a body of like form):--bottle, pitcher, psaltery, vessel, viol. see HEBREW for 05034
from 5034; stupid; wicked (especially impious):-- fool(-ish, -ish man, -ish woman), vile person. see HEBREW for 05034
the same as 5036; dolt; Nabal, an Israelite:--Nabal. see HEBREW for 05036

from 5034; a flabby thing, i.e. a carcase or carrion (human or bestial, often collectively); figuratively, an idol:-- (dead) body, (dead) carcase, dead of itself, which died, (beast) that (which) dieth of itself. see HEBREW for 05034
feminine of 5036; foolishness, i.e. (morally) wickedness; concretely, a crime; by extension, punishment:--folly, vile, villany. see HEBREW for 05036
from 5036; properly, disgrace, i.e. the (female) pudenda:--lewdness. see HEBREW for 05036
apparently from 5036 and 3909; foolish secrecy; Neballat, a place in Palestine:--Neballat. see HEBREW for 05036 see HEBREW for 03909
a primitive root; to gush forth; figuratively, to utter (good or bad words); specifically, to emit (a foul odor):--belch out, flowing, pour out, send forth, utter (abundantly).
(Aramaic) from an unused root meaning to shine; a light; plural (collectively) a chandelier:--candlestick.
of uncertain derivation; Nibshan, a place in Palestine:--Nibshan.

from an unused root meaning to be parched; the south (from its drought); specifically, the Negeb or southern district of Judah, occasionally, Egypt (as south to Palestine):--south (country, side, -ward).

a primitive root; properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise:--bewray, X certainly, certify, declare(-ing), denounce, expound, X fully, messenger, plainly, profess, rehearse, report, shew (forth), speak, X surely, tell, utter.
(Aramaic) corresponding to 5046; to flow (through the idea of clearing the way):--issue. see HEBREW for 05046

from 5046; a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before:--about, (over) against, X aloof, X far (off), X from, over, presence, X other side, sight, X to view. see HEBREW for 05046
(Aramaic) corresponding to 5048; opposite:--toward. see HEBREW for 05048
a primitive root; to glitter; causatively, to illuminate:--(en-)lighten, (cause to) shine.
from 5050; brilliancy (literally or figuratively):--bright(-ness), light, (clear) shining. see HEBREW for 05050
the same as 5051; Nogah, a son of David:--Nogah. see HEBREW for 05051
(Aramaic) corresponding to 5051; dawn:--morning. see HEBREW for 05051
feminine of 5051; splendor:--brightness. see HEBREW for 05051
a primitive root; to but with the horns; figuratively, to war against:--gore, push (down, -ing).
from 5055; butting, i.e. vicious:--used (wont) to push. see HEBREW for 05055

or nagid {naw-gheed'}; from 5046; a commander (as occupying the front), civil, military or religious; generally (abstractly, plural), honorable themes:--captain, chief, excellent thing, (chief) governor, leader, noble, prince, (chief) ruler. see HEBREW for 05046

or ngiynath (Psa. 61:title) {neg-ee-nath'}; from 5059; properly, instrumental music; by implication, a stringed instrument; by extension, a poem set to music; specifically, an epigram:--stringed instrument, musick, Neginoth (plural), song. see HEBREW for 05059

a primitive root; properly, to thrum, i.e. beat a tune with the fingers; expec. to play on a stringed instrument; hence (generally), to make music:--player on instruments, sing to the stringed instruments, melody, ministrel, play(-er, -ing).

a primitive root; properly, to touch, i.e. lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphem., to lie with a woman); by implication, to reach (figuratively, to arrive, acquire); violently, to strike (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.):--beat, (X be able to) bring (down), cast, come (nigh), draw near (nigh), get up, happen, join, near, plague, reach (up), smite, strike, touch.
from 5060; a blow (figuratively, infliction); also (by implication) a spot (concretely, a leprous person or dress):--plague, sore, stricken, stripe, stroke, wound. see HEBREW for 05060
a primitive root; to push, gore, defeat, stub (the toe), inflict (a disease):--beat, dash, hurt, plague, slay, smite (down), strike, stumble, X surely, put to the worse.
from 5062; a trip (of the foot); figuratively, an infliction (of disease):--plague, stumbling. see HEBREW for 05062
a primitive root; to flow; figuratively, to stretch out; causatively, to pour out or down; figuratively, to deliver over:--fall, flow away, pour down (out), run, shed, spilt, trickle down.
a primitive root; to drive (an animal, a workman, a debtor, an army); by implication, to tax, harass, tyrannize:--distress, driver, exact(-or), oppress(-or), X raiser of taxes, taskmaster.

a primitive root; to be or come (causatively, bring) near (for any purpose); euphemistically, to lie with a woman; as an enemy, to attack; relig. to worship; causatively, to present; figuratively, to adduce an argument; by reversal, to stand back:--(make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (hither, near, nigh), give place, go hard (up), (be, draw, go) near (nigh), offer, overtake, present, put, stand.
from 5110 in the sense of piling up; a mound, i.e. wave:--heap. see HEBREW for 05110
a primitive root; to impel; hence, to volunteer (as a soldier), to present spontaneously:--offer freely, be (give, make, offer self) willing(-ly).
(Aramaic) corresponding to 5068; be (or give) liberal(-ly):--(be minded of...own) freewill (offering), offer freely (willingly). see HEBREW for 05068
from 5068; liberal; Nadab, the name of four Israelites:--Nadab. see HEBREW for 05068

from 5068; properly (abstractly) spontaneity, or (adjectively) spontaneous; also (concretely) a spontaneous or (by inference, in plural) abundant gift:--free(-will) offering, freely, plentiful, voluntary(-ily, offering), willing(-ly), offering). see HEBREW for 05068
from 5068 and 3050; largess of Jah; Nedabjah, an Israelite:--Nedabiah. see HEBREW for 05068 see HEBREW for 03050
(Aramaic) from a root meaning to stick; a layer (of building materials):--row.

a primitive root; properly, to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down); figuratively, to rove, flee, or (causatively) to drive away:--chase (away), X could not, depart, flee (X apace, away), (re-)move, thrust away, wander (abroad, -er, -ing).
(Aramaic) corresponding to 5074; to depart:--go from. see HEBREW for 05074
passive participle of 5074; properly, tossed; abstractly, a rolling (on the bed):--tossing to and fro. see HEBREW for 05074
or nada (2 Kings 17:21) {naw-daw'}; a primitive root; properly, to toss; figuratively, to exclude, i.e. banish, postpone, prohibit:--cast out, drive, put far away.
from 5077 in the sense of freely flinging money; a bounty (for prostitution):--gifts. see HEBREW for 05077

from 5074; properly, rejection; by implication, impurity, especially personal (menstruation) or moral (idolatry, incest):--X far, filthiness, X flowers, menstruous (woman), put apart, X removed (woman), separation, set apart, unclean(-ness, thing, with filthiness). see HEBREW for 05074

a primitive root; to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.):--banish, bring, cast down (out), chase, compel, draw away, drive (away, out, quite), fetch a stroke, force, go away, outcast, thrust away (out), withdraw.
from 5068; properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant):--free, liberal (things), noble, prince, willing ((hearted)). see HEBREW for 05068
feminine of 5081; properly, nobility, i.e. reputation:--soul. see HEBREW for 05081
probably from an unused root meaning to give; a present (for prostitution):--gift.
of uncertain derivation; a sheath (of a sword):--sheath.
(Aramaic) from the same as 5084; a sheath; figuratively, the body (as the receptacle of the soul):--body. see HEBREW for 05084
a primitive root; to shove asunder, i.e. disperse:--drive (away, to and fro), thrust down, shaken, tossed to and fro.
a primitive root; to promise (pos., to do or give something to God):--(make a) vow.
or neder {nay'-der}; from 5087; a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised:--vow((-ed)). see HEBREW for 05087
from an unused root meaning to lament; lamentation:--wailing.

a primitive root; to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh:--acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth).
a primitive root; to groan, i.e. bewail; hence (through the idea of crying aloud), to assemble (as if on proclamation):-- lament, wail.
from 5091; an elegy:--lamentation, wailing. see HEBREW for 05091
feminine of 5092; lamentation:--doleful. see HEBREW for 05092
(Aramaic) or nehiyruw (Aramaic) {neh-hee-roo'}; from the same as 5105; illumination, i.e. (figuratively) wisdom:--light. see HEBREW for 05105
a primitive root; properly, to run with a sparkle, i.e. flow; hence (transitively), to conduct, and (by inference) to protect, sustain:--carry, feed, guide, lead (gently, on).
or Nahalol {nah-hal-ole'}; the same as 5097; Nahalal or Nahalol, a place in Palestine:--Nahalal, Nahallal, Nahalol. see HEBREW for 05097
from 5095; pasture:--bush. see HEBREW for 05095
a primitive root; to growl:--mourn, roar(-ing).
from 5098; a snarl:--roaring. see HEBREW for 05098
feminine of 5099; snarling:--disquietness, roaring. see HEBREW for 05099
a primitive root; to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger:--bray.
a primitive root; to sparkle, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; hence (from the sheen of a running stream) to flow, i.e. (figuratively) assemble:--flow (together), be lightened.
(Aramaic) from a root corresponding to 5102; a river, especially the Euphrates:--river, stream. see HEBREW for 05102
from 5102; a stream (including the sea; expec. the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity:--flood, river. see HEBREW for 05102
from 5102 in its original sense; daylight:--light. see HEBREW for 05102
a primitive root; to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize:--break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect.
a primitive root; to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter:--bring forth (fruit), make cheerful, increase.
or neyb {nabe}; from 5107; produce, literally or figuratively:--fruit. see HEBREW for 05107
from 5108; fruitful; Nobai, an Israelite:--Nebai (from the margin). see HEBREW for 05108

a primitive root; to nod, i.e. waver; figuratively, to wander, flee, disappear; also (from shaking the head in sympathy), to console, deplore, or (from tossing the head in scorn) taunt:--bemoan, flee, get, mourn, make to move, take pity, remove, shake, skip for joy, be sorry, vagabond, way, wandering.
(Aramaic) corresponding to 5116; to flee:--get away. see HEBREW for 05116
(only defect. nod {node}); from 5110; exile:--wandering. see HEBREW for 05110
the same as 5112; vagrancy; Nod, the land of Cain:--Nod. see HEBREW for 05112
from 5068; noble; Nodab, an Arab tribe:--Nodab. see HEBREW for 05068
a primitive root; to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty (compare 5116)), to celebrate (with praises):--keept at home, prepare an habitation. see HEBREW for 05116

or (feminine) navah {naw-vaw'}; from 5115; (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den):--comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried. see HEBREW for 05115

a primitive root; to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.):--cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare 3241. see HEBREW for 03241
or nowach {no'-akh}; from 5117; quiet:--rest(-ed, -ing place). see HEBREW for 05117
feminine of 5118; quietude; Nochah, an Israelite:--Nohah. see HEBREW for 05118
to quake:--be moved.
from 5115; residence; Navith, a place in Palestine:--Naioth (from the margin). see HEBREW for 05115
(Aramaic) or nvaliy (Aramaic) {nev-aw-lee'}; from an unused root probably meaning to be foul; a sink:--dunghill.
a primitive root; to slumber (from drowsiness):--sleep, slumber.
from 5123; sleepiness:--drowsiness. see HEBREW for 05123
a primitive root; to resprout, i.e. propagate by shoots; figuratively, to be perpetual:--be continued.
or Nown (1 Chron. 7:27) {nohn}; from 5125; perpetuity, Nun or Non, the father of Joshua:--Non, Nun. see HEBREW for 05125

a primitive root; to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver):--X abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, X hide, lift up a standard.

a primitive root; to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined):--continually, fugitive, X make, to (go) up and down, be gone away, (be) move(-able, -d), be promoted, reel, remove, scatter, set, shake, sift, stagger, to and fro, be vagabond, wag, (make) wander (up and down).
from 3259 and 3050; convened of Jah; Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess:--Noadiah. see HEBREW for 03259 see HEBREW for 03050

a primitive root; to quiver (i.e. vibrate up and down, or rock to and fro); used in a great variety of applications (including sprinkling, beckoning, rubbing, bastinadoing, sawing, waving, etc.):--lift up, move, offer, perfume, send, shake, sift, strike, wave.
from 5130; elevation:--situation. Compare 5297. see HEBREW for 05130 see HEBREW for 05297
a primitive root; properly, to flash; hence, to blossom (from the brilliancy of color); also, to fly away (from the quickness of motion):--flee away, bud (forth).
or notsah {no-tsaw'}; feminine active participle of 5327 in the sense of flying; a pinion (or wing feather); often (collectively) plumage:--feather(-s), ostrich. see HEBREW for 05327
a primitive root; to suckle:--nurse.
(Aramaic) from an unused root (corresponding to that of 5216) meaning to shine; fire:--fiery, fire. see HEBREW for 05216
a primitive root; to be sick, i.e. (figuratively) distressed:--be full of heaviness.
a primitive root; to spirt, i.e. besprinkle (especially in expiation):--sprinkle.
from 2102; something boiled, i.e. soup:--pottage. see HEBREW for 02102

or nazir {naw-zeer'}; from 5144; separate, i.e. consecrated (as prince, a Nazirite); hence (figuratively from the latter) an unpruned vine (like an unshorn Nazirite):--Nazarite (by a false alliteration with Nazareth), separate(-d), vine undressed. see HEBREW for 05144
a primitive root; to drip, or shed by trickling:--distil, drop, flood, (cause to) flow(-ing), gush out, melt, pour (down), running water, stream.
from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a nose-ring:--earring, jewel.
(Aramaic) corresponding to the root of 5143; to suffer (causatively, inflict) loss:--have (en-)damage, hurt(-ful). see HEBREW for 05143
from an unused root meaning to injure; loss:--damage.

a primitive root; to hold aloof, i.e. (intransitivey) abstain (from food and drink, from impurity, and even from divine worship (i.e. apostatize)); specifically, to set apart (to sacred purposes), i.e. devote:--consecrate, separate(-ing, self).

or nezer {nay'-zer}; from 5144; properly, something set apart, i.e. (abstractly) dedication (of a priet or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn locks; also (by implication) a chaplet (especially of royalty):--consecration, crown, hair, separation. see HEBREW for 05144
the same as 5118; rest; Noach, the patriarch of the flood:--Noah. see HEBREW for 05118
from 2247; occult; Nachbi, an Israelite:--Nakbi. see HEBREW for 02247
a primitive root; to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists):--bestow, bring, govern, guide, lead (forth), put, straiten.
from 5162; comforted; Nechum, an Israelite:--Nehum. see HEBREW for 05162
or nichum {nee-khoom'}; from 5162; properly, consoled; abstractly, solace:--comfort(-able), repenting. see HEBREW for 05162
from 5162; comfortable; Nachum, an Israelite prophet:--Nahum. see HEBREW for 05162
from the same as 5170; snorer; Nochor, the name of the grandfather and a brother of Abraham:--Nahor. see HEBREW for 05170

apparently passive participle of 5172 (perhaps in the sense of ringing, i.e. bell-metal; or from the red color of the throat of a serpent (5175, as denominative) when hissing); coppery, i.e. (figuratively) hard:--of brass. see HEBREW for 05172 see HEBREW for 05175
or nchushah {nekh-oo-shaw'}; feminine of 5153; copper:--brass, steel. Compare 5176. see HEBREW for 05153 see HEBREW for 05176
probably denominative from 2485; a flute:--(plural) Nehiloth. see HEBREW for 02485
from the same as 5170; a nostril:--(dual) nostrils. see HEBREW for 05170

a primitive root; to inherit (as a (figurative) mode of descent), or (generally) to occupy; causatively, to bequeath, or (generally) distribute, instate:--divide, have ((inheritance)), take as a heritage, (cause to, give to, make to) inherit, (distribute for, divide (for, for an, by), give for, have, leave for, take (for)) inheritance, (have in, cause to, be made to) possess(-ion).

or (feminine) nachlah (Psalm 124:4) {nakh'-law}; or nachalah (Ezekiel 47:19; 48:28) {nakh-al-aw'}; from 5157 in its original sense; a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine):--brook, flood, river, stream, valley. see HEBREW for 05157

from 5157 (in its usual sense); properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion:--heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare 5158. see HEBREW for 05157 see HEBREW for 05158
from 5158 and 410; valley of God; Nachaliel, a place in the Desert:--Nahaliel. see HEBREW for 05158 see HEBREW for 0410
apparently a patronymic from an unused name (apparently passive participle of 2492); dreamed; a Nechelamite, or descendant of Nechlam:--Nehelamite. see HEBREW for 02492

a primitive root; properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself):--comfort (self), ease (one's self), repent(-er,-ing, self).
from 5162; consolation; Nacham, an Israelite:--Naham. see HEBREW for 05162
from 5162; ruefulness, i.e. desistance:--repentance. see HEBREW for 05162
from 5162; consolation:--comfort. see HEBREW for 05162
